USER REQUEST:
Write a polynomial-time reduction from 3-Coloring to Independent Set. problems.py defines both problems: SOURCE is 3-Coloring and TARGET is Independent Set. The SOURCE and TARGET class docstrings give the exact instance formats, yes-conditions and edge cases.

PROBLEM DEFINITIONS (the SOURCE and TARGET docstrings from problems.py, complete as given here):

SOURCE = ThreeColoring
3-Coloring (graph 3-colorability).

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...]}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.

Yes iff each vertex can be given one of 3 colours so that the two
endpoints of every edge get different colours. Not every colour has to
be used.

Edge cases: n = 0 is yes. Any graph with at most 3 vertices is yes. A
graph containing 4 mutually adjacent vertices (K4) is no.

TARGET = IndependentSet
Independent Set.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has an independent set of AT LEAST k vertices: k
vertices with no edge between any two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k > n is always no. With no edges,
every set of vertices is independent.

WORKING DIRECTORY: /tmp/reduction-0st11n_5

The answer to the returned instance must be yes exactly when the answer to the input instance is yes, and reduce must run in polynomial time. Do not call the brute-force solvers inside reduce.

function.arguments:
{"command":"cat <<'EOF' > reduce.py
"""Reduction from 3-Coloring to Independent Set.

Source problem (ThreeColoring) instance format:
    {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...]}
Target problem (IndependentSet) instance format:
    {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}

The reduction constructs a graph H where each vertex of the original graph
is represented by three vertices, one for each possible colour.  Edges are
added so that an independent set of size n in H corresponds exactly to a
proper 3‑colouring of the original graph.
"""

def reduce(instance):
    """Reduce a ThreeColoring instance to an IndependentSet instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    instance: dict
        A dictionary with keys "n" (int) and "edges" (list of [u, v]).

    Returns
    -------
    dict
        An IndependentSet instance with keys "n", "edges", and "k".
    """
    n = instance.get("n", 0)
    orig_edges = instance.get("edges", [])

    # New graph has 3 vertices per original vertex
    new_n = 3 * n
    edges = []
    # Helper to compute new vertex id for (v, colour)
    def vid(v, colour):
        return v * 3 + colour

    # Add edges making each triple of colour vertices a triangle (at most one colour per vertex)
    for v in range(n):
        a = vid(v, 0)
        b = vid(v, 1)
        c = vid(v, 2)
        edges.append([a, b])
        edges.append([a, c])
        edges.append([b, c])

    # For each original edge, forbid same colour on both endpoints
    for u, v in orig_edges:
        for colour in range(3):
            edges.append([vid(u, colour), vid(v, colour)])

    # k should be exactly n (pick one colour per original vertex)
    k = n
    return {"n": new_n, "edges": edges, "k": k}

# The module may be imported; expose reduce in __all__
__all__ = ["reduce"]
EOF"}
